title: Cortex delays responses to affective demands, which enables thinking

statements.text: The essential task of cognitive, cortical consciousness is to delay motor responses to affective demands for work, and this delay enables thinking, a virtual form of action. The essential function of cortex is to stabilize executive processes in the bound state of working memory.

sources.quote: the essential task of cognitive (cortical) consciousness is to delay motor responses to affective "demands made upon the mind for work
Thinking is a virtual form of acting
